newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA'S VERON FACES FINE FOR LATE ARRIVAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA'S VERON FACES FINE FOR LATE ARRIVAL.

text.p: Argentine midfielder Juan Sebastian Veron returned to Italian club Sampdoria five days late from his Christmas break on Friday and faces a possible fine as a result.
The 21-year-old player said he had been unable to get a flight back from Buenos Aires in time.
"I'm sorry about what happened and I'm ready to pay the club if it decides to fine me," Veron told reporters at the club's training ground. "It's not that I tried to pull a fast one."
It was not clear whether Veron would be made to sit out Sunday's serie A game at Udinese.
"Veron is already a great man on the pitch but he has some growing up to do off it," Sampdoria's coach Sven-Goran Eriksson said.
